warnings: 15 RC floor-beam segments (floor at ระดับพื้นห้อง +1.30). Marks B1 / B2 / B3 read off the plan; B1' (stair-foot beam) appears only in the S-03 ST-1 detail and the S-04 sections, not on this plan, so it has no plan segment.

Two infill beams sit on no column: B2 on row A''' (y = 2.00, chains 2.00 + 2.00) between grids 2 and 3, bearing on the B3 beams of lines 2 and 3; and B1 on line 2' (x = 5.50, chains 1.50 + 1.50) from row A to row A''', bearing on the row-A B2 and the A''' B2. The B3 beams on lines 2 and 3 (A to B) are kept as one segment each — the A''' beam lands on them, it is not a support (section 5).
Row-A and row-B beams between grids 2 and 3 are kept as one segment: the B1 on 2' lands on the row-A beam and nothing lands on row B at 2'.

Columns C1: 10 printed on this plan (A1-A4, B1-B4, C2, C3). The footing plan also prints 'F1,C1' at C'2' under the stair foot, where this plan draws only the dashed stair — that 11th C1 is taken from the footing plan (structural sheet, explicit label) and included in the count; confidence lowered for it in the note.

Slab marks: S1 in the bathroom/veranda core (4 panels between grids 2 and 3), PS (precast plank, span arrow along y) in the two bedroom bays. Stair ST-01 drawn dashed beyond row C; its ref is the approximate nearest point (section 10a).
